pip._comment: starlette, python-multipart and anyio come in through mcp (its HTTP server). They are listed only as minimum safe versions (OSV: GHSA-jp82-jpqv-5vv3/GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq, GHSA-pp6c-gr5w-3c5g/GHSA-v9pg-7xvm-68hf, GHSA-82r6-8w77-94w6) because the Linux venv also sees the system site-packages, whose older copies would otherwise satisfy mcp. Same for pillow (fpdf2 and the report image code decode imported images; 43 advisories up to 13.0.0), httpx2/httpcore2 and opentelemetry-api (mcp).
pip._hashes_comment: sqlcipher3 (SQLCipher 4.20.0, bundled OpenSSL) encrypts the database; argon2-cffi(-bindings) derive the key from the PIN. The sha256 values are the published wheel hashes for the platforms LOYA ships on. RunNote.py installs `name==version` without --require-hashes (that pip mode needs a hash for every transitive dependency, which this file does not list), so they are recorded for audit and manual verification (pip download + sha256sum), not enforced at install. cffi is not pinned: cryptography already requires it, and pinning it would fight the Linux distro copy the venv also sees.

optional._comment: Not installed by RunNote.py. Each group is installed only after the user enables the matching feature and consents (Settings > Extensions > External Agents).

claude_agent.description: Claude Agent (External Agents). Installed from Settings after consent.

keyring.description: Optional OS keyring for External Agents API keys (Windows Credential Locker / Secret Service). Without it keys are PIN-encrypted or kept for the session only.
